title: Malicious code in spencer-btns (npm)
description: The spencer-btns npm package contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. Installation of this package may lead to full system compromise, including unauthorized access to secrets and keys. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but due to potential full control by an attacker, complete remediation may require additional measures such as rotating all secrets from a different, trusted machine.
